_about: Messages with known answers for the message judge's yes/no questions (data.json judge_questions). Written by Claude in chat on 2026-11-17, not by the builder who wrote the questions. 'hard' cases are reported, not counted in the pass line. The café values are those of data.json: Sunrise Café, 2026-11-21, 19:00, party of 8, name Dana Lee.
